title: Formal proof check receipt v1
$comment: Mirrors the document shape scripts/claim_proof_bundle_checker.py reads: checker identity resolves in architecture/formal_toolchains.json, version is a concrete release (never a range/alias), status is any string (the checker's claim-backing rule requires 'passed' — non-passing receipts are read and classified as typed findings, not rejected at parse), and the artifact digest binds the exact formal artifact checked.
